newsitem.title: INDIA: India's STC 96/97 net doubles to 440 mln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India's STC 96/97 net doubles to 440 mln rupees.

text.p: India's state-run State Trading Corp (STC) said on Friday that its net profit doubled to 440 million rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) from 220 million in 1995/96.
STC said in a statement its turnover increased to 23.17 billion rupees in 1996/97 from 16.85 billion in the previous year.
"The turnover increase was due to higher import sales of 16.85 billion compared to 8.57 billion in 1995/96," the statement said.
It said profit before tax rose to 640 million rupees in 1996/97 from 327 million last year.
STC has set a turnover target of 28.90 billion rupees for 1997/98, the statement added.
